text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: There are no adequate and well controlled studies with Sodium Chloride Injection, USP in pregnant women and animal reproduction studies have not been conducted with this drug.

text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Because many drugs are present in human milk, caution should be exercised when Sodium Chloride Injection, USP is administered to a nursing woman.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: The use of Sodium Chloride Injection, USP in pediatric patients is based on clinical practice.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Therefore, dose selection for an elderly patient should be cautious, usually starting at the low end of the dosing range, reflecting the greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal, or cardiac function, and of concomitant disease or other drug therapy.
